crossRefs.note: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am Yahweh.
Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians…
I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for…
“Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”
You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of…
But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I…
Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.
“You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them…
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is…
“Yahweh says: ‘Stand in the court of Yahweh’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in…
You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and…
You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord…
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “I am Yahweh. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”
translations.bsb: He said to him, “I am the LORD; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I say to you.”
translations.kjv: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I am the LORD: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say
translations.asv: that Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying, I am Jehovah: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I speak unto thee.
